current_experiment.active_feature_rule: Pair-distance or pocket-distance must be the actual registered operator, not just narrative metadata.
current_experiment.frozen: teacher, teacher clock, window, dose schedule, strength, and original B50 inputs
current_experiment.primary_intervention: one explicit local geometric observable, fixed previously selected support

contract.density_ratio: Descriptive explicit local feature proxy, not future-success probability.
contract.dose: Post-RMS actual displacement; common reward scaling can cancel.
contract.feature_profile: Online feature moments are linearly interpolated saved rows. Whole-window quadratic fits and derivatives are diagnostic, not the online control curve. Post-RMS historical contrast attenuation measures standardized descriptive separation, not calibrated reliability or future success.

local_support_selection.rule: Atom count is an upper bound from molecule coverage, never a target. Query and cite the selected region local_support_evidence; compare local contrast beyond whole-cloud similarity. Teacher trends are not cohort enrichment. Explain why every included neighbor is needed; broad historical support is a baseline, not an automatically inherited hypothesis.

contract.measurement_stages: Nonzero component VJP establishes activation only. The last live endpoint gap is before that control update. Track actual reward-matched slots separately from observational half-state matches. Compare actual half geometry to the actual half teacher, terminal geometry to the actual terminal teacher. Fixed-slot suffix tracking and terminal-rematched spatial presence are distinct: slot migration or chemical graph changes alone do not prove loss of a spatial motif. Zero clipping/constant dose are NOT retention evidence. Nonzero component VJP does not establish a changed normalized total direction; inspect fractions/cosines. Final value uses terminal affinity/quality and matched controls.
contract.registered_active_forces: pointwise/pair/band/pocket/orientation/selection operator as program says; typed/charge only when positive weights. Detached element assignment is not direct type force. A polar-selected support with pointwise reward is still geometry-only.
contract.response_routing: Response routing uses sparse per-mode coordinate VJPs of this surrogate, from the same generator forward. Gap-normalized local controllability is NOT future affinity. Nearest geometry, surrogate controllability and final outcome are separate hypotheses. Two probe times are configurable fractions of the control window; no extra generator/affinity forwards.
contract.router: One active local mode per seed, state compatibility is detached, no full-cloud union.
contract.surrogate_units: Geometry distance losses and sigma-scaled type/charge fields have A^2 units. Orientation and standardized feature log-ratios are dimensionless; relative chemical coefficients then carry compensating A^-2 units. These are optimization surrogates, not physical energies. Kernel mass is dimensionless; signed displacement components are A.
contract.teacher_roles: Terminal source roles are not early-state actual identities.

local_outcomes.assignment_source: Actual last-control-forward endpoint reward matching, held for tracked suffix. Terminal rematching is a separate spatial-pattern diagnostic, not slot retention.
local_outcomes.limits: A selected B50 pilot does not establish N1000 enrichment. Support outside input gradients reflect generator coupling, not additional teacher points. Slot migration alone cannot prove loss of the spatial motif or justify a chemical-graph gate.

R02_reference.interpretation: Common half-state observational matching, not necessarily this controller actual rewarded support. Read geometry and affinity separately.

zero_replay.interpretation: Common half-state observational matching, not necessarily this controller actual rewarded support. Read geometry and affinity separately.

local_outcomes.teacher_clocks: Actual half target for half diagnostics; actual final target for terminal diagnostics. Last live point gap is pre-update endpoint comparison and is not the pair/pocket reward value.
